hints: Each tube has a letter in brackets. The tube goes to the nozzle with that same letter.
Start with the cyan tube. Its letter is C.
config.intro: The ink pump has five tubes, and the gnu marked each one with a letter for its ink. Wire every tube to the nozzle with the same letter.

hints: Each step uses what the step before it made. Follow one fortune from its first phrase to the moment it leaves for the Oven.
The strip only travels to the Oven at the very end, once the ink is dry.
config.intro: The Fortune Machine's job list fell off the wall. Put the steps back in the order the machine does them.

steps.label: Print the checked fortune on a paper strip
Pick one phrase from each phrase bank
Send the dry strip to the end of the Oven
Read the joined fortune back to check it
Let the ink on the strip dry
Join the picked phrases into one fortune

hints: Say each pair of lines aloud. The missing word at the end of a pair must sound like the word that ends the line above it.
Look at the word that ends the line above each blank, then pick the bank word that rhymes with it and makes sense.
config.intro: A fortune in the phrase bank got jumbled, and the last word of two lines fell out. Pick the words that finish each rhyme.
lines: A fortune folded, small and neat,
To make your cup of tea taste {0}.
Take it, read it, pass it through,
Some luck for me and some for {1}.

hints: Watch the light. Tap Press only while it glows, and let the dim beat go by.
The beat is a little slower now. Take your time.
config.intro: The printer stamps a letter on every lit beat. Watch the light and press with it.

choices: In the bin by the pier
lines: Squawk! Hello, hello! I'm Seagull, and I collect lost fortunes. The ones I caught, I know word for word. The ones I missed, I haven't a feather of a clue.
Mostly they go missing at the printer. A smudged fortune gets swept off the paper strip and into the bin by the pier. I fish them out when the tide is kind.
A few blew away when the shop door was left open, and a few the gnu scribbled on napkins went out with the lunch rubbish. He was ever so sorry about that.
config.nudge: Listen to what Seagull said about smudged fortunes. Where do they get swept to?
config.question: Where do the smudged fortunes swept off the printer's paper strip end up?
config.speaker: Seagull
